milestones.title: Founding — Yandex search engine launched
milestones.summary: Arkady Volozh and co-founders launched the original search engine that became the core of the group. Created the technology and user base that underpinned the company's future expansion.

milestones.title: IPO — Listed on NASDAQ
milestones.summary: Yandex completed its U.S. IPO, raising ~$1.3B and providing public capital to fund international expansion, data centers and acquisitions.

milestones.title: Corporate rebrand — Yandex N.V. renamed Nebius Group N.V.
milestones.summary: Following the separation of Russian operations and strategic refocus, the company changed its name and ticker to reflect a new identity centered on AI infrastructure.

milestones.title: Strategic review — Goldman Sachs appointed as financial advisor
milestones.summary: Company engaged Goldman Sachs to review strategic options to accelerate investments in core AI infrastructure — signal of a decisive shift to capital-intensive cloud and data-center expansion.

milestones.title: Equity financing — $700M private placement announced
milestones.summary: Nebius secured an oversubscribed $700M strategic equity financing (including investors such as NVIDIA and Accel) to accelerate build-out of full-stack AI infrastructure.

milestones.title: Strategic pivot to AI infrastructure and product launches
milestones.summary: The group explicitly repositioned as an AI infrastructure company, launching Nebius AI Studio and expanding LLM/vision support — shifting revenue mix and capital allocation toward cloud and model offerings.
milestones.dateNote: Multi-stage program through 2024–2025; date set to end of 2024 as anchor.

milestones.title: Capital markets activity — public offerings and convertible notes
milestones.summary: Nebius completed public and private offerings raising multi-billion dollars to fund hyperscale deployments and M&A — materially increased balance sheet firepower.
milestones.dateNote: Source describes mid-2025; exact closing dates available in company filings.

milestones.title: Acquisition — Agreement to acquire Tavily
milestones.summary: Nebius moved to add agentic search and real-time search capabilities via the Tavily acquisition, extending its cloud platform functionality for real-time/agentic applications.

milestones.title: Partnership — Strategic partnership with NVIDIA
milestones.summary: Nebius and NVIDIA announced a partnership to develop hyperscale AI cloud infrastructure, strengthening access to AI accelerators and technical collaboration for large deployments.

note: All dates and content sourced verbatim from the user-provided journey file. Mid-2025 'capital markets activity' uses an approximate anchor date (2025-06-15) since the source describes a multi-stage program rather than a single closing — flagged via dateNote.
